Stocks like IREN should also benefit from this. I think of IREN as a call option on NVDA with no expiration.

Worst case, it retests the $129 200WMA and that's about it.

I can only speak from experience here. I started investing when a contract ended, wasn't sure when I'd find work again. Spent hours looking around and reading up on various assets, narrowing down the list over the day, before buying my first. Some turned hundreds into thousands. Some turned about a thousand into over 20K.
Speaking on some of my earliest wins in the first year or so. It was definitely worth putting in the time rather than just gaming the days away. So keep an eye out for opportunity and look around at least a few times a day, even check the /biz/ archives for posts involving assets you've bought. Very early on I neglected to do so and missed a 100x, which I would've found if I'd been checking for what others were saying about an asset I was considering.
It's not about starting at charts 24/7. You live in a world where people make money off of soda and games, so it's not always about what seems most practical or revolutionary. Really take the time to understand why something has potential and you'll tend to pick winners.
